---
title: "1_Heatmaps_for_MOXD1_Regulons"
output: html_document
date: "2026-03-03"
---

Heatmap with certain groupings of cells (below), showing a few TFs, the target
gene, and the peaks

x-axis: Astro-TE NN, Astro-WM NN, Astro-NT NN, Other Nonneurons, all other classes except Nonneurons and Pin;
y-axis genes: NFIA, POU3F2, NR2F1, MOXD1
y-axis peaks: chr4:135119184-135119685, chr4:134932591-134933092; chr4:135137386-135137887, chr4:135137891-135138392

# Env

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ComplexHeatmap)
    library(circlize)
    library(RColorBrewer)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(patchwork)
    library(ggrepel)
    library(ggpubr)
    library(viridisLite)
    library(grid)
    library(igraph)
    library(ggraph)
    library(scales)
    library(tibble)
    library(tidyr)
    library(purrr)
    library(stringr)
    library(GenomicRanges)
})


theme_md_classic <- function() {
    theme_classic(
        base_size = 6, 
        base_family = "ArialMT",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
        axis.title  = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.text   = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.ticks  = element_line(color = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.text  = element_text(size = 8),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}
```

# Utilities

## CPM normalization

```{r}
# rows are features, columns are samples
cpm <- function(mat) {
    t(1e6 * t(mat) / colSums(mat))
}
```

## Z-scoring

```{r}
# z-score each row in matrix
scale_rows <- function(m) {
    t(scale(t(m)))
}
```

### Subset eregulons

```{r}
ereg_neur_dir[, c("eRegulon_name"), drop=FALSE] %>% 
    unique %>% 
    mutate(
        group = sub(".*_", "", eRegulon_name),
        direct = ifelse(grepl("extended", eRegulon_name), "extended", "direct")
    ) %>% 
    .[, c("group", "direct")] %>% 
    table
#      direct
# group direct
#   -/-      7
#   -/+      7
#   +/-    119
#   +/+    188
```

### Group genes/peaks by eRegulons

```{r}
# Target genes by regulon
ereg_neur_dir_pp_genes <- ereg_neur_dir_pp %>%
    group_by(eRegulon_name) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(Gene)), .groups = "drop")

# Peaks by Regulon (if column name differs, change 'region')
ereg_neur_dir_pp_peaks <- ereg_neur_dir_pp %>%
  group_by(eRegulon_name) %>%
  summarise(peaks = list(unique(Region)), .groups = "drop")

# And now join (eRegulon_name, genes, peaks)
ereg_neur_dir_pp_both <- inner_join(ereg_neur_dir_pp_genes, ereg_neur_dir_pp_peaks, by = "eRegulon_name")
stopifnot(length(unique(ereg_neur_dir_pp$eRegulon_name)) == nrow(ereg_neur_dir_pp_both))
# > nrow(ereg_neur_dir_pp_both)
# [1] 188
# > length(unique(ereg_neur_dir_pp$TF))
# [1] 188
```

```{r}
# and direct repressors 
ereg_neur_dir_mp_genes <- ereg_neur_dir_mp %>% 
    group_by(eRegulon_name) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(Gene)), .groups = "drop")

ereg_neur_dir_mp_peaks <- ereg_neur_dir_mp %>%
  group_by(eRegulon_name) %>%

ereg_neur_dir_mp_both <- inner_join(ereg_neur_dir_mp_genes, ereg_neur_dir_mp_peaks, by = "eRegulon_name")
```


## Subset matrices & obs ! [OVERWRITE]

Will only use the intersection of the RNA and ATAC clusters (so drop that single
THM Glut cluster that lacked ATAC data).

Also only use clusters in the `preprint_analysis_include` set.

```{r}
obs <- subset(obs, !inconclusive_mapping)
obs <- obs[rownames(obs) %in% colnames(atac_by_cl_raw), ]

```

```{r}

```


```{r}
geneAUC_glia_by_cl <- as.matrix(read.csv(path_rna_auc_nn,  row.names="X"))
```

## CPM normalize RNA/ATAC matrices

```{r}
atac_by_cl_cpm <- cpm(atac_by_cl_raw)
rna_by_cl_cpm  <- cpm(rna_by_cl_raw)
```

Will not z-score the entire matrix (expensive), will only do as needed for
selected peaks.

### Get mean CPM & z-scores by Group

```{r}
stopifnot(all(colnames(rna_by_cl_cpm) == rownames(obs)))
rna_group_mean_cpm <- t(apply(
    rna_by_cl_cpm, 1, function(x) tapply(x, obs$Subcortex_Group_v4, mean)
))
```

```{r}
stopifnot(all(colnames(atac_by_cl_cpm) == rownames(obs)))
atac_group_mean_cpm <- t(apply(
    atac_by_cl_cpm, 1, function(x) tapply(x, obs$Subcortex_Group_v4, mean)
))
```

And z-scores:

```{r}
rna_group_mean_cpm_z  <- scale_rows(rna_group_mean_cpm)
atac_group_mean_cpm_z <- scale_rows(atac_group_mean_cpm)
```

## Z-score AUCell scores

For direct +/+ eRegulons, we expect both modalities to be high. Combine by 
z-scoring each matrix (per regulon across clusters) and averaging:

```{r}
geneAUC_neur_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(geneAUC_neur_by_cl)
peakAUC_neur_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(peakAUC_neur_by_cl)
```

```{r}
geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl)
peakAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(peakAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl)
```

glia

```{r}
geneAUC_glia_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(geneAUC_glia_by_cl)
peakAUC_glia_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(peakAUC_glia_by_cl)
```

```{r}
geneAUC_glia_dir_pp_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(geneAUC_glia_dir_pp_by_cl)
peakAUC_glia_dir_pp_by_cl_z <- scale_rows(peakAUC_glia_dir_pp_by_cl)
```

### AUCell z-score means by Group, Class

For regulon AUC scores, will use the cluster-level z-scores, and average them.

```{r}
geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_group_z <- t(apply(
    geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl_z, 1, function(x) tapply(x, obs$Subcortex_Group_v4, mean)
))
geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_class_z <- t(apply(
    geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_cl_z, 1, function(x) tapply(x, obs$Subcortex_Class_v4, mean)
))
```

```{r}
peakAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_group_z <- t(apply(
```

# Get grouping variables

x-axis: Astro-TE NN, Astro-WM NN, Astro-NT NN, Other Nonneurons, all other classes except Nonneurons and Pin;
y-axis genes: NFIA, POU3F2, NR2F1, MOXD1
y-axis peaks: chr4:135119184-135119685, chr4:134932591-134933092; chr4:135137386-135137887, chr4:135137891-135138392

```{r}
gns <- c("NFIA", "POU3F2", "NR2F1", "MOXD1")
pks <- c(
    "chr4:135137891-135138392",
    "chr4:135137386-135137887", 
    "chr4:135119184-135119685", 
    "chr4:134932591-134933092"
)
```


```{r}
# list with "regroup" names, elements contain taxonomic Groups
regroups <- list(
    "Astro-TE NN" = "Astro-TE NN",
    "Astro-WM NN" = "Astro-WM NN",
    "Astro-NT NN" = "Astro-NT NN",
    "Other Nonneurons" = sort(unique(filter(
        obs, 
        Subcortex_Class_v4 == "Nonneuron", 
        !grepl("Astro", Subcortex_Group_v4)
    )$Subcortex_Group_v4))
)

regroups <- obs %>% 
    filter(Subcortex_Class_v4 != "Nonneuron") %>% 
    .[, c("Subcortex_Class_v4", "Subcortex_Group_v4")] %>% 
    unique %>% 
    (function(x) split(x$Subcortex_Group_v4, x$Subcortex_Class_v4)) %>% 
    c(regroups, .)
```

## Get RNA & ATAC avg z-scores

```{r}
rna_regoups_mean_cpm_z  <- sapply(regroups, function(x) rowMeans(rna_group_mean_cpm_z[,  x, drop=FALSE]))
atac_regoups_mean_cpm_z <- sapply(regroups, function(x) rowMeans(atac_group_mean_cpm_z[, x, drop=FALSE]))
```

## Get ereg avg z-scores

```{r}
geneAUC_regroups_neur_dir_pp_z <- sapply(
    regroups, function(x) rowMeans(geneAUC_neur_dir_pp_by_group_z[, x, drop=FALSE])
)

geneAUC_regroups_glia_dir_pp_z <- sapply(
    regroups, function(x) rowMeans(geneAUC_glia_dir_pp_by_group_z[, x, drop=FALSE])
)
```

```{r}
geneAUC_regroups_comb <- rbind(
    geneAUC_regroups_neur_dir_pp_z[
        unlist(sapply(gns, grep, rownames(geneAUC_regroups_neur_dir_pp_z), value=T)),
        ,
        drop=F
    ] %>% `rownames<-`(., paste0("Neuron: ", rownames(.))),
    geneAUC_regroups_glia_dir_pp_z[
        unlist(sapply(gns, grep, rownames(geneAUC_regroups_glia_dir_pp_z), value=T)),
        ,
        drop=F
    ] %>% `rownames<-`(., paste0("Glia: ", rownames(.)))
)

rownames(geneAUC_regroups_comb) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(geneAUC_regroups_comb))
```

### peak rename map

```{r}
pk_rnm <- c(
    "chr4:135137891-135138392" = "E1",
    "chr4:135137386-135137887" = "E2",
    "chr4:135119184-135119685" = "E3",
    "chr4:134932591-134933092" = "E4"
)
```

## Heatmap

```{r}
# will put these in order at the beginning, and everything else comes after
cl_ord <- c("Astro-TE NN", "Astro-WM NN", "Astro-NT NN", "Other Nonneurons", "TEL Glut", "SEP GABA")

rbind(
    rna_regoups_mean_cpm_z[gns, ],
    atac_regoups_mean_cpm_z[pks, ] %>% `rownames<-`(., pk_rnm[rownames(.)])
) %>% 
    (function(x) {
        x[x > 5]  <- 5
        x[x < -5] <- -5
        x
    }) %>% 
    .[, c(cl_ord, setdiff(colnames(.), cl_ord))] %>% # doing the order thing
    Heatmap(
        name = "z-score",
        col = col_fun,
        row_split = factor(
            c(rep("Genes", length(gns)), rep("cCREs", length(pks))),
            levels = c("Genes", "cCREs")
        ),
        column_split = factor(
            c(rep("Glia", 4), rep("Neurons", length(regroups)-4)),
            levels = c("Glia", "Neurons")
        ),
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        cluster_columns = FALSE,
        show_row_names = TRUE,
        show_column_dend=FALSE,
        show_row_dend=FALSE,
        heatmap_legend_param = list(
            title = "z-score",
            at = c(-5, 0, 5),
            title_gp  = gpar(fontfamily = "ArialMT", fontsize = 8, fontface="bold"),
            labels_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ArialMT", fontsize = 6),
            legend_height = unit(12, "mm"),
            grid_width    = unit(2.5, "mm")   # thickness of colorbar
        ),
        row_names_gp    = gpar(fontfamily = "ArialMT", fontsize = 6),
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ArialMT", fontsize = 6),
        row_title_gp    = gpar(fontfamily = "ArialMT", fontsize = 8), # split labels ("Genes", "cCREs")
        column_title_gp = gpar(fontfamily = "ArialMT", fontsize = 6)
    ) -> hm
hm
```

```{r}
pdf(file.path(pdir_plots, "heatmap_zscore_genes_peaks2.pdf"), width=2.7, height=1.7)
print(hm)
invisible(dev.off())
```
